helplines.label: Rail Madad – integrated railway helpline
helplines.purpose: Security, medical assistance (press 1 / * for an agent), enquiries, complaints and suggestions. 12 languages; works from any phone.

sources.name: Business Standard – Railways announces integrated Rail Madad helpline 139
DoT circular – merger of 182 helpline into 139

helplines.notes: The RPF security helpline 182 was merged into 139; short code 182 was withdrawn from 1 April 2021 (DoT circular). Use 139 for security on trains and stations.

helplines.label: National emergency (police, fire, health)
helplines.purpose: Single pan-India emergency number under the Emergency Response Support System.

helplines.label: Child helpline
helplines.purpose: Children in need of care and protection; lost or missing children. 24×7.

policy: Only nationally published numbers are listed. 182 is not listed: it was merged into 139 and withdrawn from 1 April 2021. Regional numbers need an official source and are not included.
